source.author: lucan
source.text: Has ad bella rates non flexo limite ponti, Certior haud ullis duxit Cynosura carinis.
source.text_original: Has ad bella rates non flexo limite ponti, / Certior haud ullis duxit Cynosura carinis.
source.text_english: This fleet, with no bending course of the sea, the Cynosure guided more surely than any other ships to war.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ille tibi cultusque deum delubraque gentis instituet, cum tu, genitor, lucebis ab omni parte poli, neque iam Tyriis Cynosura carinis certior aut Grais Helice servanda magistris, sed tu signa dabis, sed te duce Graecia mittet et Sidon Nilusque rates.
reuse.text_original: ille tibi cultusque deum delubraque gentis / instituet, cum tu, genitor, lucebis ab omni / parte poli, neque iam Tyriis Cynosura carinis / certior aut Grais Helice servanda magistris, / sed tu signa dabis, sed te duce Graecia mittet / et Sidon Nilusque rates.
reuse.text_english: He will establish for you both the worship of the gods and the shrines of the race, when you, father, shall shine from every part of the sky; and now neither will Cynosura be safer for Tyrian ships, nor Helice for Greek helmsmen, but you will give the signs, and under your leadership Greece will launch its ships and Sidon and the Nile as well.
